_about: Planned topics for specific publish dates (America/Los_Angeles). The daily run checks this before picking a topic: if the publish date it is making a short for has an entry, make that topic. Dates without an entry use the normal topic choice.

gta6_week.why: GTA 6 launches Nov 19, 2026 (PS5 / Xbox Series X|S). Search interest peaks around launch, so a 5-part mini-series of real engineering explainers with a genuine GTA 6 connection runs Nov 16-20, then the channel returns to everyday topics.
rules: The video must genuinely be about the topic linked to GTA 6; the game is the hook, the content is real engineering.
Never claim how GTA 6 works internally unless Rockstar has confirmed it publicly (find and cite the source). Explain how open-world games generally do it, or the real-world equivalent.
No Rockstar footage, logos, characters, key art or in-game screenshots. Our own drawings only (generic cars, generic Florida-style city, diagrams).
Mentioning GTA 6 by name in the title, description and tags is fine for these episodes only. Never add GTA tags to other episodes.
Title format: '<hook question> 🎮 #GTA6 #shorts' (under 100 characters). Description ends with: 'Hidden Mechanics is not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.'

2026-11-16.topic: The real Vice City: how Miami's drawbridges (bascule bridges) open
2026-11-16.angle: GTA 6 is set in a fictional Florida; Miami's river is lined with drawbridges. Counterweights, trunnions, how a huge leaf lifts with modest motors, why boats get priority. Real Miami/Florida facts only.

2026-11-17.topic: Car crashes in games vs. real life: why real cars crumple on purpose
2026-11-17.angle: Games make crashes look spectacular; real cars use crumple zones and a rigid safety cell to slow the stop and protect people. Energy, time to stop, airbags.

2026-11-18.topic: Real speed cameras vs. GTA's wanted system: how radar and lidar catch speeders
2026-11-18.angle: Doppler radar vs. lidar laser timing, how the camera matches plate to speed. Contrast with a game's wanted stars only in general terms.

2026-11-19.topic: How open-world games load a whole city with no loading screens (GTA 6 launch day)
2026-11-19.angle: Streaming the world in chunks around the player, levels of detail (simpler models far away), predicting where you're heading, why driving fast is hard for the game. General open-world technique; GTA 6 specifics only if officially confirmed.

2026-11-20.topic: How game traffic and pedestrians decide where to go
2026-11-20.angle: Navigation meshes / road graphs, pathfinding (A* style), simple rules that make crowds look alive. General game AI; tie to open-world games like GTA.
